entities.name: Johanne Charlotte Unzer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johanna Charlotte Unzer , was a German writer and philosopher, famed for her progressive views on women's education. She was awarded the imperial Dichterkrone in 1753. She is known for her anacreontic poetry.
